results_due: late January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (28 Oct to 6 Nov)
reasoning: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of 25-30% (about ₹2,650-2,720 Cr on FY26's ₹2,093 Cr) and said H2 will be about 60% of the year. H1 was ₹1,110 Cr, so H2 needs about ₹1,560-1,665 Cr. We assume Q3 is a little under half of that: ₹760 Cr (+32% on Q3 FY26's ₹576 Cr, +26% on Q2).

Drivers: dispatches rising from 1,911 machines as the new 10,000-machine capacity and the foundry start, and Huron dispatches from Q3-Q4 (an analyst's ₹80-100 Cr for Q3 was called a 'right understanding').
Margin: Q2 consolidated operating margin was 21.8%. To reach 25% for the year H2 needs about 27%; we assume 24.5% in Q3 as Huron revenue (about ₹60 Cr not recognised in H1) starts to flow.
risks: Huron export licences or the French investigation delay dispatches
Foundry and new plant ramp slower than planned
Margin stays near 22% if Huron revenue lags
